Buy Tickets Join legendary guitarist Andy Timmons on Friday, November 13th at The Sanctuary in McKinney, TX, for a one-of-a-kind world premiere performance celebrating his brand-new record, The Outlier Nocturnes, a collection of solo pieces for electric guitar that are almost classical in nature. The evening will be filmed for future release. Set 1: The Storyteller Set Andy breaks down the creative curtain, introducing each song individually to share the deeply personal inspiration, artistic process, and emotional stories behind his Chopin-inspired solo compositions before performing them live. Set 2: Outlier Nocturnes In Full & Solo Classics Following a brief intermission, Andy returns to the stage to perform the entire Outlier Nocturnes album uninterrupted from start to finish—allowing the music to flow as a singular, cohesive piece. To close out the night, he will deliver a selection of his acclaimed solo guitar arrangements featuring timeless classics by The Beatles, Brian Wilson, Queen, and a few spontaneous surprises. Age: All Ages.
